title: ר' ירמיה בן אלעזר

paragraphs: R. Yirmeyah ben Elazar. There were two: one a tanna of a baraita and one an amora. Chapter HaRo'eh (58, beginning of side a; 60a as printed; compare 61a); chapter Osin Pasin (18a–b), and on folio 19a, many expositions; chapter Ḥelek (109a). There is also R. Elazar ben Yirmeyah, who lived in Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel's generation (see his entry).
